158:     def get_reduced_costs(
159:         self, vars_to_load: Optional[Sequence[VarData]] = None
160:     ) -> Mapping[VarData, float]:
161:         if self._solver_model.Status != gurobipy.GRB.OPTIMAL:
162:             raise NoReducedCostsError()
163:         if self._solver_model.IsMIP:
164:             # this will also return True for continuous, nonconvex models
165:             raise NoReducedCostsError()
166:         pyomo_vars, vals = self._get_var_values(vars_to_load, "Rc", 0)
167:         return ComponentMap(zip(pyomo_vars, vals))

169:     def get_duals(
170:         self, cons_to_load: Optional[Sequence[ConstraintData]] = None
171:     ) -> Dict[ConstraintData, float]:
172:         if self._solver_model.Status != gurobipy.GRB.OPTIMAL:
173:             raise NoDualsError()
174:         if self._solver_model.IsMIP:
175:             # this will also return True for continuous, nonconvex models
176:             raise NoDualsError()
177: 
178:         qcons = set(self._solver_model.getQConstrs())
179:         con_map = self._get_con_map()
180:         if cons_to_load is None:
181:             cons_to_load = con_map.keys()
182: 
183:         duals = {}
184:         for c in cons_to_load:
185:             gurobi_con = con_map[c]
186:             if type(gurobi_con) is tuple:
187:                 # only linear range constraints are supported
188:                 gc1, gc2 = gurobi_con
189:                 d1 = gc1.Pi
190:                 d2 = gc2.Pi
191:                 if abs(d1) > abs(d2):
192:                     duals[c] = d1
193:                 else:
194:                     duals[c] = d2
195:             else:
196:                 if gurobi_con in qcons:
197:                     duals[c] = gurobi_con.QCPi
198:                 else:
199:                     duals[c] = gurobi_con.Pi
200: 
201:         return duals
